correctness.rationale: Condition on Pi(i)=j. If j=i there is a fixed-point cycle and a uniform S_(n-1) complement, yielding 1+H_(n-1); if j!=i contract the forced directed edge, preserving cycle count and giving H_(n-1). Thus Cov(C,1_{Pi(i)=j})=(n-1)/n^2 on the diagonal, -1/n^2 off it. Summing proves the universal trace law. Plugging a_ij=(i-j)^2 gives Cov(C,D)=-(n^2-1)/6; Bernoulli-cycle variance H_n-H_n^(2) and permutation Spearman variance 1/(n-1) give exact correlation and decay. Independently enumerated all permutations n=2..6 for a non-symmetric polynomial array and D.
residual_risks: Covariance zero is not independence. Formula presumes uniform S_n; no nonuniform extension claimed.

final_claim: For uniform Pi in S_n (n>=2) and deterministic real array A, Cov(C_n, sum_i a_{i,Pi(i)})=tr(A)/n-sum(A)/n^2, yielding Cov(C_n,D_n)=-(n^2-1)/6 and Corr(K_n,R_n)=-sqrt(n-1)/(n sqrt(H_n-H_n^(2))).
limitations: Universal trace law proven via contraction; independent finite census only through n=6.
